title: paracraft operation record
description: a declared operation type in the paracraft vocabulary. an operation is what the studio says it is doing to the metal: removing material, adding relief, piercing, or building a freestanding element. the harness does not infer operations from mesh geometry; the parameter state declares them. constraints attach to operations via applies_to_ops in the profile schema.

op_id.description: stable identifier for this operation type. used as the value in a declaration record's op field and in constraint applies_to_ops arrays.

semantic_class.description: the class of material relationship this operation creates. subtractive: material removed from an existing body (engrave, mill). additive: material raised above an existing surface (emboss, raised relief). perforation: a through or blind void that goes to the extent of the body (through hole, pilot divot). freestanding_element: a body attached at a base but free at its tip (wire, prong, stub).

description.description: prose description of what this operation physically does and how it differs from adjacent operations.

canonical_properties.description: the measured or declared property names that rules for this operation type may reference. these are the dimensions a declaration record must supply for the harness to evaluate constraints. example: engrave requires depth_mm and width_mm; emboss requires height_mm and neck_mm.

applies_to_constraints.description: constraint ids from the active profile that are specifically meaningful for this operation type. a constraint can appear in multiple op records. this list is informational; the authoritative gate is applies_to_ops on the constraint itself.

status.description: drafted: op vocabulary entry is under review. active: the op is exercised by at least one benchmark model and its constraints have passed the harness.

notes.description: optional rationale, known conflicts, or scope limits.
